properties.name: app.mail.enabled
properties.description: Activa el envio de mails (requiere EMAIL_SENDER y EMAIL_SENDER_PASSWORD reales)

properties.name: app.seeding.enabled
properties.description: Habilita los seeders CommandLineRunner (desactivar en prod)

properties.name: app.security.google.post-login-redirect
properties.description: URL del frontend a la que se redirige tras el login OAuth2

properties.name: app.security.jwt.cookie-name
properties.description: Nombre de la cookie httpOnly con el JWT local

properties.name: app.security.jwt.refresh-cookie-name
properties.description: Nombre de la cookie httpOnly con el refresh token

properties.name: cloudinary.url-config
properties.description: url de configuracion de Cloudinary necesita tres parámetros, 'public api key' : 'secret api key' @ 'cloudname'

properties.name: chatbot.similarity.threshold
properties.description: chatbot minimum score to be considered a valid question

properties.name: token.expiration
properties.description: Minutos de validez del JWT local
